details:
An UI change would be good thing for the World, Friend, List because (FavCat mod) used to be put the favorite list to the top of every thing and would be good if this feature could be change able in the normal game UI to. 
An UI Lock feature for the Settings menu and Customize to because It is annoying to go to the setting then every time turn of my HUd because of the mic icon is annoy me and I just want to see the gestures and face mirror. And the lock for locking all of the changes for every session. Incluiding the Near clip and evry little feature because infuriating to change it every time to 0.01 🙂
 
For the IK team Would be cool if the colliders 1. Not stop my avatar if I go inside a collider (It can be abused But FUN) OR 2. push me back if I hit a collider (It can make you VR sick). Because every time If I lean over something it is not allowing it because the avatar collider move whit the body and not with the feet. and leaning over like a fence it is not possible if it has collider. 
Advanced invite where you could drop a portal for friends if somebody invited you! Or Self invite portal drop. 
Camera Local/synced flashlight. Good for night maps If we want to make pics 
Join notification. ( I don't like to be scared because somebody is behind me. I have heart problems!!! And don't want to die because of VR 🙂 RN using VRCX for it) 
Panorama screenshot with the camera and with this 3D camera because In (Shh in Neos) it is realy good to watch back image memories in 3D ☺️ (Steam VR) Has it but it is 1:1 would be cool if it is 16:9 full image. 
 Loading screen Random Screenshot Pics (Choseable default is the about and stuff) Behind the same as it is right now! And Loading screen Music Change! Playing the game from 2017 and it is not changed scince then it is time to chose our music for it! but left it for default the original. 
Nameplate Stats as an user Trust rank and avatar detail default without opening the menu! And Colored user plate with the trust level! 
Quick Menu Clock! And session time. With Fps and ping what is availabe right now. 
QR code reader. 
That is my list. Thanks VRC devs if you read it :) Hope you guys have a great day.
title: Fav in top, Setting Lock, Ik update, Inv portal place, Cam flash, Notification, Panorama+3D pic, Nameplate color+stats, QM clock, QR code reader
